verdict.rationale: No first-party documentation in the pack describes code search. Community comments do indicate that GitHub has a native code search feature: one notes logins became required to search code [github-comm-6], and another calls the search 'terribly bad' compared with cloning and using grep [github-comm-12]. The capability appears to exist but is thinly evidenced and criticized. missing for 10: first-party docs on code search, explicit evidence of cross-repository search scope, query syntax/filters, API or CLI search access, positive hands-on corroboration
